title: Lunch Charge Used in Prepayment Quotes by Enrolled Campus — School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The lunch charge a prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts follows the campus on the student's enrollment record in status enrolled, as held in the district's Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions records: the CEP meal charge at Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary or Hollis Middle School; the secondary lunch charge of the student's meal status at Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School or Mesquite Ridge High School; the elementary lunch charge of the student's meal status at any other campus or when the student holds no enrollment record in status enrolled.

Only the enrollment record in status enrolled is read; the meal account's own campus does not decide this charge.

| Campus on the enrollment record in status enrolled | Lunch charge a prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts |
|---|---|
| Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary, Hollis Middle School | the CEP meal charge (0.00) |
| Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School, Mesquite Ridge High School | the secondary lunch charge of the meal status |
| any other campus | the elementary lunch charge of the meal status |
| no enrollment record in status enrolled | the elementary lunch charge of the meal status |

## Cases (hypothetical students)

- A student on Paid Meal Status, enrolled at Calloway Creek High School: 3.45.
- A student on Reduced-Price Meal Status, enrolled at Sunflower Early Childhood Center: 0.40.
- A student on Paid Meal Status, enrolled at Pecan Grove Elementary: 0.00.
- A student on Paid Meal Status whose only enrollment record is in status withdrawn: 3.10.
